ideas.pitch: A spatial-temporal incident forecasting tool built for Texas power grids using Poisson GAMs and rolling backtests to predict localized infrastructure failure probabilities under extreme weather.
ideas.title: Houston Energy Grid Risk & Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy data science modeling directly mirroring winning projects like ai-incident-forecasting, appealing to judges who value rigorous statistical validation over basic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and intake platform specifically tailored for Houston medical center clinics, automating initial intake trust-building and preliminary triage.
ideas.title: TexMed Autonomous Patient Triage & Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of Global-Smile by targeting localized high-value healthcare administration use cases with high perceived commercial impact.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection and investigation dashboard combining graph intelligence and LightGBM to screen maritime supply chains in the Houston Ship Channel for compliance anomalies.
ideas.title: GulfCoast GreenSupply AML & Compliance Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph intelligence and complex machine learning matching the award-winning Bito platform to demonstrate deep technical execution.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and campus sustainability platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents to optimize campus resource consumption and student counseling.
ideas.title: EcoCampus Multi-Agent Student Support & Sustainability Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the architecture of the GreenNovation Hackathon winner by deploying orchestrated multi-agent workflows for tangible institutional problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring pipeline that tracks land-use changes and environmental compliance for industrial developments across Texas.
ideas.title: AgriSustain Satellite Industrial Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the computer vision and geospatial processing success of GeoNex-ATLAS, offering judges a visually impressive mapping interface backed by real spatial analytics.
